Entries.Original: This "Garden of Memories" contains powers that will help you reach your destiny.
You might not be able to do much here yet, but the garden will gradually grow as you do.

Try your hand at the flashback battles
found nearby the cafeteria.
The Garden of Memories seems to have grown along with your experience.

You are now able to travel to both Union Street and the woodway!
Attempt the new flashback battles there to gain valuable upgrade materials for crush- and pierce-type Memorias.

You can dramatically increase your squad's rating
by equipping the accessories obtained from flashback battles.

If your squad's rating is not making the grade,
then try gathering better accessories for each of your squad's units.
You can return to the Home screen from here.
You can return to the Home screen by pressing the L1 button.
